title: Virgin Media O2 starts rollout of 2Gbps broadband over its gigabit cable network for the first time
summary: The post Virgin Media O2 starts rollout of 2Gbps broadband over its gigabit cable network for the first time appeared first on Liberty Global .
body_markdown:
Virgin Media O2 has announced the rollout of 2Gbps broadband services over its gigabit cable network for the first time, with upgrades already complete in 18 locations and due to expand to the majority of its network in 2027.


The upgrade, which is cost effective and requires no civil engineering, means Gig2 is now available in areas served by Virgin Media O2’s DOCSIS-based HFC network. Upgrades to the company’s cable network have already taken place for around 3 million homes, and with Virgin Media’s Gig2 services also available in fibre areas, this means more than 10 million households* can get access to the provider’s fastest broadband today.


By delivering this 2Gbps upgrade over HFC for the first time, Virgin Media O2 is extending multi-gigabit capability beyond full fibre areas and demonstrating the continued potential of its existing fixed network infrastructure. The milestone reflects the company’s ongoing investment in its network to support rising data demands from households and businesses.


Gig2 offers average download speeds of 2,000Mbps and upload speeds of 100Mbps on Virgin Media’s HFC network, giving customers substantially more capacity for data-intensive services such as cloud applications, connected home technology, streaming, gaming and remote working.


The deployment also supports wider demand for high-capacity connectivity across the UK, with reliable gigabit-capable broadband increasingly important for local economies, digital services and productivity. Virgin Media O2’s network already reaches millions of homes and businesses, offering multi-gigabit speeds regardless of the underlying network technology.


**Jeanie York, Chief Technology Officer at Virgin Media O2, said:** “This is an important milestone for our fixed network. Ultimately, people don’t care what kind of pipe is connecting them as long the service is fast, reliable and delivers what is expected.


“By making 2Gbps speeds available over cable for the first time, we’re extending multi-gigabit capability to more parts of the UK and showing the continued potential of our existing network infrastructure that still very much meets the increasing needs of consumers. As demand for data continues to grow, we’re investing across our network to deliver faster, more reliable connectivity.”


[Read the full release.](https://news.virginmediao2.co.uk/virgin-media-o2-starts-rollout-of-2gbps-broadband-over-its-gigabit-cable-network-for-the-first-time/)
